model.name: Lab · TI2V-5B FastWan e01 (smoke only)
model.description: Lab smoke preset only — pure I2V, no trajectory. Compare against lab_wanmove_e01. Do NOT use as pose-pass / ship signal. 5B pure I2V plateau on uncross→open documented 2026-07-26.
model.infos:
## Smoke only

- FastWan 3–4 steps, short clip
- No custom_guide
- pose_gate will usually fail open_end — expected
- Use for UI/pipeline sanity, not leg side-switch
model.prompt_infos: Same short uncross prompt as Move for fair A/B; expect weaker geometry control.

prompt: Same woman as the start image, seated upright, locked face. Slowly uncross legs: lower the top knee until both knees are level, then slide knees apart left-right until thighs sit side by side with a clear gap. Hands leave the knee. Feet stay down. No kick. Static camera.
negative_prompt: hand stuck on knee, kick, raised leg, lying down, frozen cross, thighs stacked, morphing face, camera move, zoom, pan
